fields.name: Name
fields.description: The label to use for this consent recording.

fields.name: Recording
fields.description:
The consent audio recording file. Maximum size is 10 MiB.

Supported MIME types:
`audio/mpeg`, `audio/wav`, `audio/x-wav`, `audio/ogg`, `audio/aac`, `audio/flac`, `audio/webm`, `audio/mp4`.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: The BCP 47 language tag for the consent phrase (for example, `en-US`).

fields.name: Object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `audio.voice_consent`.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the consent recording was created.
